library_preparation_preflight.summary: Broadening coverage requires exercising Realm/Valve/naming subsystems (JNDIRealm, JAASRealm, DefaultInstanceManager, JDBCAccessLogValve, DataSourceLinkFactory, etc.) that the current single TomcatTests.java never reaches. The sibling 11.0.18/11.0.22/11.0.23 test suites for this same library already did this and needed two extra testImplementation dependencies, but no Docker image or external service - JNDI/JAAS/JDBC realms are all exercised with in-memory/mocked substitutes.

deterministic_setup.reason: In-memory JDBC driver used by JDBCAccessLogValve/DataSource-backed naming-resource tests (jdbc:h2:mem: URL) - no container needed. Version matches what's already proven for this library's 11.0.18/11.0.22/11.0.23 suites.

Supplies @Resource/@PostConstruct/@PreDestroy types needed to drive DefaultInstanceManager's annotation-based reflective injection path. Same coordinate used across this library's newer sibling test suites.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: No Docker image or real directory/LDAP/database server is required: JNDIRealm tests mock SSL hostname verification rather than contacting a real LDAP server, JAASRealm tests use a local tomcat/jaas-realm-resource.config test resource, and JDBC-backed tests use an in-memory H2 URL. If tests are added that exercise JreCompat/classloader-leak-prevention/digester-system-property paths (mirroring JreCompatTest, JreMemoryLeakPreventionListenerTest, DigesterTest in the 11.0.x suites), add these JVM args to the javaTest task: --add-opens=java.base/java.io=ALL-UNNAMED, --add-opens=java.base/java.lang=ALL-UNNAMED, --add-opens=java.base/java.lang.reflect=ALL-UNNAMED, --add-opens=java.base/java.util=ALL-UNNAMED, --add-opens=java.rmi/sun.rmi.transport=ALL-UNNAMED, and the system property -Dorg.apache.tomcat.util.digester.PROPERTY_SOURCE=org.apache.tomcat.util.digester.SystemPropertySource. Only add the specific flags a given new test actually needs rather than copying all of them speculatively. If any such test runs under nativeTest, also set runtime arg -Djava.home=<JAVA_HOME or GRAALVM_HOME>.
risks: jakarta.annotation-api 3.0.0 targets Jakarta EE 11 while 10.0.20 otherwise pins jakarta.servlet-api 5.0.0 (EE9); it's additive and compiles fine (confirmed by the 11.0.x precedent), but a stricter EE-generation match would be 2.0.0/2.1.1 if that's preferred.

Precedent is based on later Tomcat versions (11.0.x); confirm via local checkMetadataFiles/test runs that the same Realm/Valve/naming classes are structurally unchanged in 10.0.20 before relying on it, since local Gradle and Native Image verification remain authoritative.
